subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A x B' means ‘A is the son of B’,

'A – B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,

'A + B' means ‘A is the wife of B’,

'A % B' means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is M related to T if ‘M + N – P x S % T’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 x
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Brother
 son
 Father
 
 

 

Given: M + N – P x S % T

It means: M is the wife of N, N is the brother of P, P is the son of S and S is the father of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f447dcf7b6c3f80a70b9338fe6a813c0a6262f4f349bc6ab3bee63436e80678.png] 

So, M is the '**Brother's wife'** of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
